description: Create, review or change Home Assistant automations, scenes and routines that run by themselves on a trigger or schedule.
examples: Create an automation that turns off all lights at midnight
Turn on the porch light at sunset every day
Write an automation to close the garage door at 10pm if it's open
Set up a routine that dims the living room lights when I start a movie
Make the thermostat drop to 65 when everyone leaves
Notify me if the front door is open for more than five minutes
Automate the sprinklers to run at 6am on weekdays
Build an automation that turns on the hallway light when motion is detected at night
Add a rule that locks the doors at bedtime
Create a scene called movie night
Turn the heater off automatically when a window opens
Set up a good morning routine
negatives: Turn off the kitchen lights right now
Add a dentist appointment to my calendar
continuations: let me see the YAML code
